content: Gancio (gancio.org, AGPL, v1.28.2 stable / 2.0 beta Oct 2026): small-node local shared agenda; anonymous event submission enabled by default; optional moderation and public 'report an event' (off by default, admin email on report); exports via RSS (global, per place, per tag, per collection), global and per-event ICS with 'Add to calendar' button, iframe/webcomponent embed, ActivityPub, microdata; sitemap endpoints for events/places/tags; ICS import from URL; tags, places, collections, announcements. No personal timelines.
